quotes.text: This work presents a digital twin (DT) technology framework concentrating on dynamic resource allocation in supply chain scheduling.
The methodology is tested in a simulated manufacturing supply chain environment and evaluated against static scheduling models using Dijkstra's algorithm.
quotes.section: Abstract, p. 5 (Dijkstra is a shortest-path algorithm, not a scheduling baseline, and it is never mentioned again in the body)

quotes.text: Demand, equipment failure, and delivery delays are predicted using machine learning algorithms: decision trees, and recurrent neural networks (RNNs).
